commits.author: Julian Eggers
commits.message:
Modernize build, CI, publishing and test tooling (#135)

* Modernize build, CI, publishing and test tooling

Aligns the project with the avides/spring-rabbit modernization applied
to xpath-helper: Java 21 baseline, central-publishing-maven-plugin
instead of the now-defunct OSSRH/nexus-staging + github-release-plugin
pipeline, pinned GitHub Actions with SonarCloud analysis, and full
JUnit 4 -> JUnit 5 Jupiter test migration (dropping unused
EasyMock/PowerMock, @Before -> @BeforeEach). Also declares
commons-lang3 as an explicit dependency instead of relying on it
transitively through xpath-helper, and updates README badges.

* Import Spring Boot BOM for dependencyManagement; bump to Spring Boot 3.5.16

Adds a dependencyManagement import of spring-boot-dependencies (same
version as avides/spring-rabbit) so Spring/Spring AMQP/AssertJ/JUnit
versions no longer need to be pinned explicitly. Fixes the resulting
fallout from the Spring 5 -> 6 jump: NestedRuntimeException no longer
appends "; nested exception is ..." to messages, so ChainedUnmarshaller
now reconstructs that detail itself instead of relying on Spring's
removed behavior, and the affected test assertion is loosened to not
pin the classpath-sensitive XOM parser location suffix.

* Simplify main source: dedupe class/superclass reflection logic, remove dead code

ParserAnalyzer repeated the same "check class, then superclass" pattern
four times; extracted into a single classAndSuperclass() helper used by
all four analysis steps, preserving the exact class-first /
superclass-overwrites precedence the Overwritten*Parser fixtures rely
on. XomUnmarshaller.unmarshal() had a null-check on preParseInterceptor
that can never be false (both constructors guarantee non-null).
ChainedUnmarshaller now uses String.join instead of StringUtils.join
for its trivial error-list joining.

* improvements

* Add missing trailing newlines

POSIX/git convention: text files should end with a newline.

* release rc1

* release rc2

* release

* fix
